section_summary.extract_value: This section details mediation analyses conducted to examine how body esteem and body orientations mediate the relationship between body-related talk (exercise talk, weight loss talk) and body appreciation. The results, based on 5000 bootstrapped samples and presented across Figure 1(a) to 1(d), indicate varying degrees of mediation. For instance, body esteem fully mediated the relationship between exercise talk and body appreciation, while only performance orientation mediated this relationship in another model. For weight-loss/diet talk, attitudes toward appearance partially mediated the relationship, but neither performance nor appearance orientation mediated it in a separate analysis. The text describes a single set of analyses without explicitly naming a study.
